description: MANGAL-NAV 2.0 - AI powered autonomous Mars rover navigation system. We use real NASA Mars Trek data at Jezero Crater to find safest path using A* algorithm with MinHeap (O n log n). Avoids craters, rocks, calculates battery & slope safety. Solo developer from Lucknow, India. Skills: AI, JavaScript, Leaflet.js, Pathfinding. Live demo ready! Let's explore Mars!
summary: Mars is full of dangers like craters, steep slopes, and high radiation. Our tool uses NASA MOLA elevation data to find the safest and shortest path for astronauts.We tested it on 50+ Mars locations. It successfully avoided all danger zones and also showed nearby ice/water areas for survival.Our mission: Make Mars travel safe for humans.
